source_baseline.selector: The singular main-target candidate is selected by docs/status/CURRENT_STATE.json and docs/governance/ACTIVE_BRANCHES.json; this recorded PR number is revision provenance, not a permanent selector.
source_baseline.rule: Movement of the base or candidate invalidates exact-head execution and review bindings but does not authorize scope reduction. Predecessor pull requests remain historical and transfer no acceptance credit.

non_negotiable_principles: Keep the complete Nakama OSS D0-D8 denominator; the core-delivery track cannot increase parity percentages or delete mandatory leaves.
Converge to one first-party trnm-server composition root and one supervised lifecycle; temporary binaries require an explicit removal edge.
Production cryptography uses reviewed libraries or an independently accepted provider; private SHA, HMAC, tag comparison, randomness and key storage are forbidden on production paths.
Public HTTP, gRPC and WebSocket framing uses maintained protocol libraries; handwritten codecs are quarantined to bounded compatibility fixtures with differential evidence.
PostgreSQL is the first release-candidate operational profile; CockroachDB remains a separately evidenced target profile and cannot inherit PostgreSQL credit.
No synchronous dual business write, no external I/O inside mutable database transactions and no acknowledgement before durable commit or exact receipt replay.
Source completion, successful CI, evidence admission, independent acceptance and production promotion remain distinct states.
Administrator and human-review facts cannot be synthesized, self-approved or auto-closed by repository code.

delivery_tracks.purpose: Deliver one operable Trillionnium golden vertical slice without claiming repository-wide Nakama replacement.
scope: HTTP, generated gRPC and persistent realtime ingress
PostgreSQL transaction, receipt, event and outbox
response-loss, restart, reconnect, backup and rollback evidence

delivery_tracks.purpose: Retain and close every mandatory Nakama OSS compatibility leaf through reviewed denominator, oracle and consumer evidence.

phases.title: Freeze singular integration and preserve truthful control state
work: Keep exactly one non-main main-target integration object selected by CURRENT_STATE and ACTIVE_BRANCHES; stack reviewed child changes on that line and never transfer predecessor evidence.
Machine-check this closure program and the cross-language component documentation registry.
Reject any status promotion based only on source presence, workflow count or edited status JSON.
exit_criteria: architecture and component registries pass hostile validation
all claim boundaries remain fail closed

phases.title: Remove private cryptographic primitives from active server paths
work: Move database-backed server JWT verification and refresh hashing onto a reviewed cryptographic provider.
Keep strict epoch routing, exact issuer and audience checks, bounded parsing, lifetime checks and no-fallback behavior.
Replace every remaining production-path custom constant-time helper with a reviewed comparison primitive.
Introduce KMS, HSM or approved secret-manager providers without exposing raw key bytes to handlers.
exit_criteria: no production binary reaches private SHA or HMAC code
wrong length, wrong epoch, tamper, rotation and revoke corpora pass
dependency, provenance and independent security acceptance are retained

phases.title: Converge server and ingress architecture
work: Move the temporary database-backed binary into the unique trnm-server composition root atomically.
Use maintained HTTP and WebSocket framing libraries while preserving narrow compatibility adapters above them.
Route adapters through command and query services rather than direct repository access.
Supervise listeners, connection actors, database work, outbox workers and drain under one cancellation tree.
exit_criteria: one production binary and no duplicate composition authority
bounded keep-alive, frame, queue, deadline and drain behavior
official client and immutable-oracle differential for the golden slice

phases.title: Make PostgreSQL the first complete operational profile
work: Complete catalog invariants, transaction fault points, cancellation, ambiguous commit reconciliation and concrete effect adapters on PostgreSQL.
Execute profile-appropriate backup, PITR, RPO and RTO rehearsal before release promotion.
Retain CockroachDB as a separate target profile with its own restart, leaseholder, failover, PITR and endurance evidence.
exit_criteria: zero acknowledged command loss, duplicate visible effect, stale writer acceptance and partial commit
accepted PostgreSQL restore and rollback packet
no transfer of PostgreSQL evidence to CockroachDB

phases.title: Close denominator, oracle and official-consumer proof
work: Classify and independently lock all fourteen denominator families without deleting mandatory leaves.
Build immutable and instrumented oracle images and execute the approved corpus ten times per lane.
Run supported official SDK clients against both oracle and candidate profiles.
Obtain distinct family decisions and a separate global SG1 decision.
exit_criteria: zero unexplained P0 or P1 divergence
conflict-free reviewers accept exact artifacts and current candidate identities

phases.title: Complete distributed, operational and migration closure
work: Obtain administration-scoped no-bypass governance read-back and ordinary protected admission.
Provision redundant conflict-free reviewers for governance, security, database, protocol, compatibility and SRE domains.
Complete multi-node ownership, partition, takeover, capacity, rolling upgrade and 24h, 72h and 7d endurance evidence.
Execute shadow, exclusive canary, rollback, cutover and retirement only after dependent gates pass.
exit_criteria: all external administration and reviewer facts are independently accepted
all product and operational gates are evidence-derived pass
Nakama retirement receives a separate explicit decision
